description: This header file defines an interface class 'FFMPEGDispatch' for dispatching calls to FFmpeg libraries, including function pointers for various FFmpeg functions, version support constants, and registration mechanisms.

classes.name: FFMPEGDispatch
classes.description: Interface class providing function pointers and methods for dispatching FFmpeg library calls, managing version support, and registration.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FFMPEGDispatch.

methods.name: RegisterSpecialization
methods.description: Registers an FFmpeg decoder specialization for specific library versions.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the dispatch object is valid.

methods.name: OpenCodec
methods.description: Ensures thread-safe opening of an FFmpeg codec.

methods.name: CloseCodec
methods.description: Ensures thread-safe closing of an FFmpeg codec.
